ngaap.guidance: 2021 guidance initiated 29-Jan-2021: Revenue $18.5 billion - $18.9 billion, up organically 3.0% - 5.0%. GAAP net income margin of 10.8% - 11.1%. Adjusted EBIT margin of 18.0% - 18.5%. GAAP EPS of $9.80 - $10.11. Non-GAAP EPS of $12.60 - $13.00. Operating cash flow and adjusted free cash flow of $3.1 billion - $3.2 billion and $2.8 billion - $2.9 billion, respectively. ~$2.3 billion in share repurchases, excluding use of divestiture proceeds. Quarterly dividend raised 20% from $.85 to $1.02 per share; new $6 billion share repurchase authorization. Guidance tables (CY'21): revenue $18,500 - $18,900; net income $2,002 - $2,090; net interest expense ~255; income taxes 310 - 364; L3Harris Merger integration costs 75 - 100; amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ~688; total adjustments 1,328 - 1,407; adjusted EBIT $3,330 - $3,497 (18.0% - 18.5%). EPS bridge: GAAP $9.80 - $10.11; integration 0.36 - 0.48; amortization ~3.34; NCI portion ~(0.02); total pre-tax 3.68 - 3.80; income taxes 0.88 - 0.91; after-tax 2.80 - 2.89; non-GAAP $12.60 - $13.00. Cash flow: operating cash flow $3,100 - $3,175; additions of PP&E ~(375); free cash flow 2,725 - 2,800; cash used for integration 75 - 100; adjusted FCF $2,800 - $2,900.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS = income from continuing operations per diluted share attributable to common shareholders, excluding L3Harris Merger integration costs, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (ALL acquired intangibles, incl. Exelis), fair-value inventory step-up, divestiture expenses/losses, restructuring and other items, impairment of goodwill and other assets / COVID-19 charges, net of the noncontrolling-interest portion and of income taxes. Adjusted EBIT = net income + discontinued operations + net interest expense + income taxes + the same pre-tax items (i.e. it INCLUDES non-operating income / non-service FAS pension income). Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net additions of PP&E + cash used for L3Harris Merger integration (and transaction) costs. Free cash flow = operating cash flow - additions of PP&E + proceeds from sale of PP&E. Dollar tax effect / NCI portion not published in this period's documents; the Q4-21 release later shows fiscal 2020 EBIT adjustments 1,704 (653 Aviation Systems + 1,053 unallocated items - 2 non-operating), income-tax effect (280), non-GAAP income from continuing operations 2,512 and non-GAAP pre-tax income 3,026. The prior-year non-GAAP EPS shown (10.26) and adjusted EBIT (3,039) are PRO FORMA calendar 2019 and are not recorded. Revenue excluding Commercial Aviation Solutions and Public Safety: 17,193 vs 16,278 pro forma (+5.6%).

pension.notes: 10-K: 'Pension adjustment' 389 = non-service components of net periodic pension and postretirement benefit income, reported in non-operating income (non-operating income 401 = pension adjustment 389 + gain on extinguishment of debt 2 + other 10). Service cost: pension 65 + other benefits 2 = 67. Net periodic benefit income: pension (309), other benefits (12). Qualified pension plan contributions 8. A FAS/CAS operating adjustment was not reported in this era (segments include FAS pension income; introduced with the 2022 segment recast, which shows 135 for fiscal 2020).

notes: is.op_income is COMPUTED (revenue - cost of sales - ESA - other operating lines): neither the release nor the 10-Q prints an operating income line (the statement goes straight to income before income taxes); it equals the sum of segment operating income and the reconciling lines. Unlabeled totals in lines_raw carry bracketed labels; EPS lines are prefixed 'Basic:' / 'Diluted:'. Annual record: is / cf / bs lines_raw are the 10-K statements (10-K wins); weighted-average share lines are from the Q4 release (prefixed 'Release:'; the 10-K income statement does not print them). Differences vs the Q4 release: the release income statement combines product and service revenue / cost lines; the release cash flow combines 'Postretirement benefit plan income and share-based compensation' (11) and shows a condensed working-capital section ('Other' 14); totals are identical. bs.tl is COMPUTED = total current + total non-current liabilities. The release compares with 'pro forma' prior-year figures (Article 11 combined Harris + L3, 8-K of 4-May-2020) and 'adjusted pro forma'; those are NOT used in any main key or in py (py = prior-year GAAP column as printed).
